title: IT Operations Report — Q3 2026
key_sentences: All core services met their availability targets this quarter.
The service desk resolved tickets faster than in any quarter since 2024.
Three major incidents affected tenants directly.
Each incident has a completed review, and all eleven follow-up actions are tracked in the problem register.
At the current growth rate the object store will need expansion within eighteen months.

rows: Expired TLS certificate on the identity proxy; renewal job had been disabled during a migration.
Carrier routing change, reverted by the carrier.
Card payments delayed, no data lost
Database failover stalled on a full transaction log.

list_items.text: Move of the repairs system to the new data centre
Retirement of the legacy document store (delayed to Q1 2027)

furniture: NORTHGATE MUTUAL HOUSING GROUP · IT OPERATIONS

groups:
  - name: tenant-portal
    rules:
      - alert: PortalHighLatency
        expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(portal_request_seconds_bucket[5m]))) > 1.5
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: page
        annotations:
          summary: "Portal p95 latency above 1.5 s for 10 minutes"
